plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: if [ -n "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then [ "$EXPECTED_VERSION" = "${nextRelease.version}" ] || { echo "built $EXPECTED_VERSION but would release ${nextRelease.version}" >&2; exit 1; }; elif [ -n "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ]; then echo "version=${nextRelease.version}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

The web app is live at https://maxgfr.github.io/aparte/.

Prebuilt `aparte` CLI binaries for macOS and Linux (arm64, x86_64). Install with Homebrew: `brew install maxgfr/tap/aparte`, or download the binary for your platform, check it against SHA256SUMS and its build provenance (`gh attestation verify aparte-<target> --repo maxgfr/aparte`).
